description:
Returns a grouped/sectioned view of Configurable Field Sets for a company.
Field sets are grouped by their type, category, inspection type, generic tool, etc.
This endpoint provides the same data structure used in the admin UI for managing field sets.
The grouping logic is determined by the type parameter(s).

Accepts either a single type or an array of types. Sections for all requested types
will be returned in a flat array.

parameters.name: types[]
parameters.description:
The configurable field set type(s) to determine how to group the results.
Can be a single string or an array of strings.
This is required to determine the grouping logic.

parameters.name: correspondence_types
parameters.description:
The configurable field set correspondence type(s) to filter results by.
Can be a single string or an array of strings.

data.description: Array of Configurable Field Set Sections

items.description: A grouped/sectioned view of configurable field sets

I18n_name.description: Internationalization name key or actual name

configurable_field_sets.description: Array of configurable field sets in this section

default_fields.description: Default fields configuration for this section

show_procore_default.description: Whether to show Procore default option

configurable_field_set_default_id.description: ID of the default configurable field set

incident_type_id.description: Incident type ID (only present for incident type sections)

equipment_category_id.description: Equipment category ID (only present for equipment category sections)

disable_creation.description: Whether creation should be disabled for this section

project_counts.description: Project counts for field sets in this section

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid type parameter
